description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Quality Review' functionality within the ERPNext quality management module. It defines a test case class that verifies the creation and deletion of a 'Quality Review' document, ensuring that it correctly references a 'Quality Goal'.

classes.name: TestQualityReview
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase class that tests the creation and deletion of Quality Review documents in the system.

methods.name: test_review_creation(self)
methods.description: Tests the creation of a Quality Review by retrieving a Quality Goal, invoking the review process, and verifying the existence and contents of the resulting Quality Review document.
